reuse.why: Changes only the existing shared isNonWorkingDay predicate, which every weekend/holiday path already calls.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the MM-DD match is added once in the single holiday predicate.

placement.why: The holiday-matching rule lives in shared/schedules.ts next to the other non-working-day logic.

scope.why: A three-line change to one function plus focused tests.

maintainability.why: Minimal and clear; the day.slice(5) trick is slightly implicit and could use a comment or named helper explaining the MM-DD form.
